climate.overview_html: The Antalya Leaders’ Summit runs 11-12 November at COP31 in Türkiye, after talks opened with a dispute over climate finance. The hosts' headline proposal is a voluntary 35% electricity share of final energy by 2035. The WHO has classified El Niño health impacts as an emergency for the first time.

items.headline: COP31 opens in Antalya with an early split over climate finance
items.summary: Finance and trade items divided developed and developing countries before the agenda was adopted on day one. The US sent no officials, and an EU official said there was no political will for new funding pledges.

items.headline: COP31 hosts push a voluntary 35-by-35 electrification goal
items.summary: The goal is for electricity to supply 35% of final energy by 2035, with talks focused on implementing existing pledges rather than new targets.

items.headline: Kurum takes COP31 presidency with Bowen leading negotiations
items.summary: More than 90,000 people are expected in Antalya through 20 November under the co-presidency agreed at COP30.

items.headline: WHO classifies El Niño health impacts as an emergency for the first time
items.summary: The move follows WMO's warning that El Niño could reach record strength by December.

major_events.name: Storm Charles — Portugal, Madeira, Spain
major_events.status: Red warnings; moving NE to Italy, Croatia
major_events.impact: Portugal is under a nationwide state of alert with gusts to 140 km/h forecast in exposed areas; Madeira logged over 200 incidents overnight. AEMET red warnings cover rain in Ávila and Cáceres and wind on La Palma; western Andalusia may see 100-300 mm.

major_events.name: Central Vietnam floods
major_events.impact: Rain is forecast to exceed 400 mm in places; 1,577 houses were inundated in Thanh Hoa and rivers are rising from Quang Tri to Dak Lak.

major_events.name: Typhoon Cempaka (Samuel)
major_events.impact: The storm passed close to Chichijima overnight Nov 10-11 and is moving away at about 26 mph, forecast to become extratropical.

major_events.name: St. Johns River flooding — Florida
major_events.impact: The river stood at 16.98 ft at Cocoa against a 17 ft major stage, with a forecast crest near 17.1 ft; water moves north into Seminole and Volusia counties this week.

major_events.name: South Africa heatwave and fire danger
major_events.impact: SAWS expects highs near 40°C in the Northern and Western Cape, with extremely high fire danger across four provinces.

major_events.name: Tropical Storm Pena — Central Pacific
major_events.impact: Pena is no longer forecast to become a hurricane and is passing far south of Hawaii.

weather.overview_html: Storm Charles has put Portugal under a nationwide alert and triggered red warnings in Spain before it tracks toward Italy and Croatia. Central Vietnam faces over 400 mm of rain in places. In Florida the St. Johns River is cresting near major flood stage at Cocoa, while AccuWeather has called the Atlantic tropical season over.

items.headline: Storm Charles floods Lisbon as Portugal enters state of alert
items.summary: Lisbon logged about 50 incidents, mostly flooding, between midnight and 10am with no injuries. Gusts to 120 km/h were forecast for Faro, and red warnings covered parts of Madeira and the southern mainland.

items.headline: Spain puts 14 regions on alert for Storm Charles, red in Ávila and Cáceres
items.summary: La Palma is under a red wind warning with gusts near 130 km/h. Cádiz and Huelva could see 100-300 mm over the episode before the storm moves toward the Alps and Italy.

items.headline: Central Vietnam braces for more than 400 mm of rain
items.summary: Ha Tinh and northern Quang Tri expect 100-250 mm, and 1,577 houses are already under water in Thanh Hoa. A landslide cut Road 9C in Quang Tri.

items.headline: St. Johns River reaches 16.98 ft at Cocoa, near major flood stage
items.summary: Water enters homes near Lake Poinsett and Rockledge at 17.2 ft; the forecast crest is about 17.1 ft, close to TS Fay's 2008 mark. The flooding follows more than 20 inches of rain in under 24 hours in southern Brevard.

items.headline: South Africa heatwave to last until Friday with 40°C highs
items.summary: SAWS flags extremely high fire danger over the Northern Cape, North West, Free State and northwestern Western Cape.

items.headline: First winter storm floods Gaza tents, killing at least five
items.summary: An embankment collapsed onto tents near Deir al-Balah. The UN counts about 26,000 flooded households among roughly 1.4 million people in tents or makeshift shelters.

items.headline: AccuWeather declares the 2026 Atlantic tropical season over
items.summary: The call comes three weeks before the official 30 November end of a season whose first hurricane formed only on 8 October.

items.headline: Northeast US coastal storm to bring rain and high-elevation snow Nov 12-14
items.summary: Pennsylvania could see up to 3 inches of rain, with 3-6 inches of snow above about 3,000 ft before colder air arrives around 15 November.

renewables.overview_html: A wind lull sent German day-ahead power to €345.64/MWh, with evening quarter-hours above €600, the highest French prices since December 2022. Euronews looks at how solar-heavy grids fare in a cloudy, windless winter. Saudi Arabia opened a 1.9 GW solar tender.

items.headline: Wind lull pushes German day-ahead power above €600/MWh in evening hours
items.summary: German day-ahead settled at €345.64/MWh and French at €334.12/MWh, the highest since December 2022, as low wind hit Germany, the UK and Benelux. The UK grid operator warned of tight Monday-morning supply.

items.headline: Europe's solar fleet faces its first test of a cloudy, windless winter
items.summary: Dunkelflaute periods push grids onto gas backup, though solar still delivers about 25-35% of its annual output in winter.

items.headline: Siemens Gamesa breaks even on a large offshore wind order
items.summary: Parent Siemens Energy reported a record fiscal 2026.

items.headline: BNEF sees US midterm results as a net positive for battery storage
items.summary: BNEF's Derrick Flakoll cites new unified Democratic state governments such as Pennsylvania and Wisconsin, but tighter data-centre rules could slow storage demand.

items.headline: Saudi Arabia opens qualification for 1.9 GW of solar in round eight
items.summary: SPPC's request covers two projects; pre-qualification closes 22 November.

science.overview_html: An ECMWF study for SOFF finds that filling surface-observation gaps could cut short-range forecast uncertainty in Africa by about 30%. A new arXiv paper runs GraphCast inside a coupled EnVar-EnKF system with real observations. MTG-I2 has returned its first images ahead of 2.5-minute rapid scans over Europe.

items.headline: ECMWF study links more surface observations to better forecasts out to 7 days
items.summary: Commissioned through the Systematic Observations Financing Facility, the study estimates that closing the observation gap could cut short-range forecast uncertainty in Africa by about 30%. In-situ surface data from sparse regions remains a gap AI models also depend on.

items.headline: GraphCast propagates ensemble covariances in a realistic EnVar-EnKF cycle
items.summary: Run for a month with real observations including microwave radiances, the ML-driven ensemble gave spread and covariances comparable to an all-MPAS reference with lower RMSE against GFS analyses. Spurious correlations near the model top degraded results there.

items.headline: MTG-I2 weather satellite returns first Flexible Combined Imager images
items.summary: Launched on 27 August, the satellite will run EUMETSAT's 2.5-minute rapid scan over Europe and North Africa alongside Meteosat-12. Operations are expected in Q2 2027.

items.headline: S-MODE flights show winds track SST across fronts with a 2-7 km lag
items.summary: Airborne observations from two S-MODE cases show stronger winds over warmer water and weaker winds over cooler water, with the atmosphere lagging SST gradients by about 2-7 km.
items.meta: Li, He et al. · Journal of Geophysical Research: Oceans

items.headline: Non-cyclone systems drive up to 75% of extreme tropical rainfall
items.summary: Tracking all tropical weather systems, the team found that systems other than tropical cyclones produced 45-75% of extreme three-hourly rainfall in some regions.

items.headline: Seafloor algae records show models overestimate Arctic winter sea ice
items.summary: Grading 27 climate models against 6,000-year-old sediment proxies trims projected winter ice by about 1 million km². The figures are re-weighted projections, not new observations.

items.headline: Cave records show ice-age abrupt climate shifts were slower than ice cores imply
items.summary: Annual layers in speleothems indicate the abrupt transitions took longer than ice-core records suggested.

items.title: Spire Global Q3 revenue rises 42% to $18.0M; shares fall on miss
items.body_html: Spire reported Q3 revenue of $18.0M, up 42% year on year and 77% excluding the sold maritime unit, with a $20.3M net loss and $175.4M in remaining performance obligations. Q4 guidance is $23M to $28M. Shares fell about 15% after hours; NOAA radio occultation and microwave sounding work featured on the earnings call.

items.title: The Weather Company launches Proximity, a 90 m microscale forecast layer
items.body_html: Proximity resolves temperature, dewpoint, wind and precipitation type down to 90 m using an AI-plus-physics, variable-resolution approach focused on mountains, coasts and cities. It is live now on Wundermap for Weather Underground premium users, with Storm Radar and the new Peak Ready app to follow.

items.title: ICEYE books three Rocket Lab Neutron launches; Muon Space books two
items.body_html: Rocket Lab signed 8 Neutron missions worth over $515M in Q3, led by ICEYE with 3 dedicated launches from late 2028 and Muon Space with 2. Neutron's base price rose to $70M. Dedicated rides give both constellations control over orbit and refresh timing.

items.title: Rheinmetall ICEYE Space Solutions picks Manufacturo for SAR satellite production
items.body_html: The German-Finnish joint venture selected Manufacturo as its production and quality management platform. The JV recently began building SAR satellites in Neuss.

items.title: Xweather launches Met-in-a-box, running Atmo's AI model on local observations
items.body_html: Vaisala's Xweather unveiled Met-in-a-box, which builds a custom AI forecast for a country or operating area from local radar, lidar and station data, on dedicated hardware, cloud or on-premises. Vaisala claims 40,000x faster runs and 50% better accuracy than NWP, unverified. It is the first product since the Atmo acquisition closed in late October and targets met services and defence.

items.title: Saildrone signs Umoe Mandal to build next-generation Surveyor USVs
items.body_html: Saildrone and Norwegian shipbuilder Umoe Mandal signed a production agreement at Euronaval for the Surveyor V3, with Umoe building composite hulls and Saildrone supplying autonomy and electronics. The deal formalizes a plan first announced in August.
